changeSummary: Every CurrentStopWorklistSnapshot item gains the required, nullable field eqp, MES's EQP of the demand verbatim for display on the pickup scan list and the unload list only, the vector CV-WORKLIST-EQP-DISPLAY-ONLY binds both implementations to decide nothing by it, the error registry is unchanged, and a 6.0.0 implementation rejects every worklist carrying the field as schema-invalid because the item is closed, so both implementations move to 7.0.0 together.
runtimeRule: Exact ProtocolVersion and exact materialized ProtocolReleaseIdentity required; no negotiation.
optionalFieldPolicy: No optional payload fields exist in this candidate. Future optional fields require proof that omission and ignore preserve safety and business conclusions.
historyPolicy: Published tags, commits, manifests, schemas, vectors and approvals are immutable; defects require a superseding release.
